fm: FM is modulation of the frequency of the carrier wave.
FM can also mean a radioactive transuranic metallic element produced by bombarding plutonium with neutrons.
FM means the same as frequency modulation or fermium or atomic number 100.
fmri: A fMRI is a form of magnetic resonance imaging of the brain that registers blood flow to functioning areas of the brain.
FMRI means the same as functional magnetic resonance imaging.
